basic_details.job_title: BPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2027 – Apply Online for 12 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC), Patna, has invited applications for 12 posts in 3 roles under Advt No. 23/2026. The posts include Physics, Chemistry, Math. The online application is open from 22 December 2026 to 21 January 2027.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online payment. Last date to pay the fee: 21 January 2027.

age_limit.age_details: Minimum 30 years and maximum age limit is not fixed (as on 1 August 2026)

qualification.education_qualification: Ph.D. degree in the relevant subject with First Class or equivalent at Bachelor's or Master's level, plus 8 years experience.

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Ph.D. degree in the Physics and First Class or equivalent at either Bachelor's or Master's level in the Physics. Experience required: Minimum of 8 years of experience in teaching/research/industry out of which at least 2 years shall be post Ph.D experience. At least total 6 Research Publications in SCI journals/UGC/AICTE approved list of journals. Age limit: Minimum 30 years and maximum age limit is not fixed. Pay: Level-13A1 (Initial pay Rs. 1,31,400 ). Qualification required: Ph.D. degree in the Chemistry and First Class or equivalent at either Bachelor's or Master's level in the Chemistry. how_to_apply: Visit official website www.bpsc.bihar.gov.in and complete One Time Registration (OTR).
Log in using credentials and create profile through the 6 steps.
Proceed to application tab and fill the online application form.
Pay required application fee and submit the application.
Download hard copy of application form and keep safely for document verification.
important_instructions: Candidates must ensure all eligibility conditions before applying. Hard copy of application and documents are required to be presented at the time of document verification.

content_sections.heading: How Will BPSC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Academic Background (Weightage-20) Evaluation of Academic Performance, Research Performance, Domain Knowledge and Teaching skill (Weightage-60) Viva-voce (Weightage-20) Selection will be based on total weightage of 100 marks including academic background, research performance, teaching skill and viva-voce interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Matriculation certificate/mark sheet for date of birth proof Bachelor degree and mark sheets Ph.D. degree certificate Caste certificate Residential certificate Creamy layer free certificate for EBC/BC EWS certificate Disability certificate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BPSC Recruitment 2027 Online
content_sections.text: Visit official website www.bpsc.bihar.gov.in and complete One Time Registration (OTR). Log in using credentials and create profile through the 6 steps. Proceed to application tab and fill the online application form. Pay required application fee and submit the application. Download hard copy of application form and keep safely for document verification. Apply on or before 21 January 2027.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates must ensure all eligibility conditions before applying. Hard copy of application and documents are required to be presented at the time of document verification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for BPSC Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: The last date is 21 January 2027. Applications opened on 22 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in BPSC Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: There are 12 vacancies: 5 Physics, 4 Chemistry, 3 Math.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for BPSC Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 21 January 2027.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General / Others: Rs. 100. Biometric Fee (if Aadhaar number not inked): Rs. 200.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 30 years and maximum age limit is not fixed (as on 1 August 2026).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level-13A1 (Initial pay Rs. 1,31,400 ) for Physics, Level-13A1 (Initial pay Rs. 1,31,400 ) for Chemistry, Level-13A1 (Initial pay Rs. 1,31,400 ) for Math.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ph.D. degree in the relevant subject with First Class or equivalent at Bachelor's or Master's level, plus 8 years experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Reservation benefits are applicable only to the native residents of Bihar.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Academic Background (Weightage-20). Evaluation of Academic Performance, Research Performance, Domain Knowledge and Teaching skill (Weightage-60). Viva-voce (Weightage-20). Selection will be based on total weightage of 100 marks including academic background, research performance, teaching skill and viva-voce interview.

faq.answer: Bihar.
